title: Real Madrid president Florentino Perez calls for fresh elections, intends to stand again
content:
Real Madrid president Florentino Perez called for fresh elections at the club and says he intends to stand again during a rare and hastily arranged appearance in front of the media on Tuesday.

The timing of the press conference led to widespread speculation that the 79-year-old may announce his resignation from a role he has held since June 2009.

Instead, the first thing he said on facing the media was: “I’m sorry to tell you that I’m not going to resign.”

Perez, who also served as Madrid president from 2000-2006, added: “Those who want to come out and stand against me, they can. I am also going to stand to defend the rights of our members.

“If somebody does want to stand, let them stand. But don’t move in the shadows. I have asked the electoral board to begin the process of calling elections, in which the current board will stand again.”

Perez has been elected unopposed in each of Madrid’s past four elections, held in 2013, 2017, 2021 and 2025
